request.research_question: How does chain-of-thought prompting affect reasoning accuracy and faithfulness in large language models?

plan.research_question: How does chain-of-thought prompting affect reasoning accuracy and faithfulness in large language models?

queries.text: "chain-of-thought prompting" AND ("reasoning accuracy" OR "reasoning performance") AND ("large language model" OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Directly targets empirical work on how chain-of-thought prompting changes reasoning performance in LLMs.

queries.text: ("chain-of-thought" OR "step-by-step reasoning") AND (faithfulness OR "faithful reasoning" OR "rationale faithfulness") AND ("large language model" OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Focuses on whether generated chains of thought faithfully reflect the model reasoning process.

queries.text: ("chain-of-thought prompting" OR "reasoning traces") AND ("causal mediation" OR "mechanistic interpretability" OR "causal intervention") AND ("language model" OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Connects prompting studies with causal and mechanistic methods used to assess whether reasoning traces are causally involved rather than post-hoc explanations.

queries.text: ("scratchpad prompting" OR "rationale prompting" OR "step-by-step prompting") AND (accuracy OR correctness) AND ("large language model" OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Retrieves adjacent terminology for chain-of-thought-style prompting and its effects on answer correctness.

queries.text: ("chain-of-thought" OR rationale) AND ("unfaithful explanations" OR "post-hoc rationalization" OR "plausible but incorrect") AND ("language model" OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Targets studies identifying misleading, post-hoc, or otherwise unfaithful rationales produced by language models.
